{{Quote|I have located the crash site of Shadow Squadron - poor, brave men.|[[I-M3]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Shadow Squadron''' was an [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] the squadron was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where at least three [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of it were shut down and crashed to their [[Death/Legends|deaths]].
